description: Build on merged PR #2071 and completed auto-revert-code-under-test-attribution; do not duplicate the dotted-JUnit parser fix. #2068 and #2073 demonstrate that successful failure detection can still propose an unrelated revert. Extend scripts/post_merge_signature.py and existing develop-post-merge incident/advisory flow. Explicitly supersede the current no-extractable-path=>revert default only for unproven attribution: unknown must retain red CI and an owned incident, not be treated as safe or be automatically reverted.

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a snapshot, a queued review, a skipped hook or an unbound passing check as completion
anti_patterns.instead: Bind actual evidence to the relevant PR/head/input and retain an explicit owned next action
anti_patterns.why: The observed session repeatedly lost asynchronous work or overstated evidence

preserves.behavior: KEEP_IDLE and SHADOW_ONLY remain in force for skip/shard/demotion/reduced-refresh proposals; this plan does not activate them.
Keep GitHub native merge queue as the only merger; no privileged steward, bypass actor, direct protected-branch push, or new bot credential.
Preserve required PR, merge_group, and post-merge coverage, soundness maintainer review, explicit user authority, and durable hold labels.

prior_art.concept: Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority
Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority

verifications.description: Post-merge attribution and incident recovery preserve true failures
verifications.expected: exit 0; behavioral negative controls fail on the prior implementation

work_units.notes: Verify #2071 is integrated, retain its real incident-format parser tests, and record the policy change from unknown attribution proposing a revert to unknown attribution requiring diagnosis with red CI/incident owner. Preserve proven same-subsystem regressions and signature deduplication.
work_units.summary: Retain the merged parser fix and explicitly revise unknown-attribution policy

work_units.notes: Capture immutable failing commit/PR, test/job identifiers, relevant source-input identities, predecessor evidence and ownership match in one existing incident artifact. Distinguish code regression, external-ref drift, environment/transient failure, stale run and unknown. Never infer causal ownership from temporal adjacency alone.
work_units.summary: Capture immutable incident inputs and distinguish failure ownership classes

work_units.notes: Only propose an automatic revert when attribution evidence supports the changed subsystem; otherwise create/update the existing idempotent advisory/incident with next action and owner. Inspect current target state and proposed revert diff before retrying or closing; newer green unrelated runs cannot certify the exact failed input.
work_units.summary: Propose reverts only with supported attribution while keeping unknown failures red and owned

work_units.notes: Replay actual #2068 BigQuery dotted-JUnit and #2073 ledger-ref incidents plus genuine owned regressions, unmappable job failures, missing evidence, reruns and a revert that introduces another failure. Verify no wrong revert for the incident fixtures, no suppressed real regression, and no duplicate incidents.
work_units.summary: Replay both bad reverts and genuine regressions without duplicate incidents
